en.name: Allows capacity to be set based on the total number of infants and young children
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Ordinance on Standards for Facilities and Operation of the Infant and Other Childcare Attendance Support Program
en.summary: The rules set by providers of infant and other childcare attendance support services will allow user capacity to be set as the combined number of infants and young children. Related provisions will also be revised. The ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Allow user capacity to be set based on the combined number of infants and young children
who: Providers of infant and other childcare attendance support services
Providers of infant and other childcare attendance support services
en.why: The ward says this is because some of the standards for facilities and operation of the program were revised.
